run_iterative_closest_point: run the iterative closest point algorithm to align two point clouds with optional scale estimation
test_icp_init_transformation: test ICP convergence by initializing from a mid-iteration transformation and comparing final results
test_icp_heterogeneous_inputs: test ICP produces identical results when given Pointclouds objects versus padded tensor inputs
test_icp_compare_with_trimesh: test ICP results match the trimesh registration ICP implementation across multiple point cloud sizes
test_corresponding_points_alignment: test corresponding points alignment across all combinations of scale estimation, reflection, and weighted inputs
